snippet.title: Bounce + Grapple! CUBOUNCE Physics Platformer Gameplay
snippet.description:
My first game demo is out! 
CUBOUNCE is a physics-based platformer where you drag to launch and swing with grappling hooks.

🎮 Play demo for free: https://vidoblank.itch.io/cubounce

#indiegame #platformer #gamedev #physicsgame #gamedemo #grapplehook
